caption: The drawing shows a circular object centered on a plain light beige background. The object appears to be a round medallion or seal with a raised edge decorated by evenly spaced small vertical lines forming a border. Inside the circle, there is a symmetrical floral design in shades of brown, with a central tulip-shaped flower having elongated, curved petals and several smaller, straight elements resembling stems or leaves radiating upward. On either side of the central flower, there are star-shaped geometric patterns with six points, also in brown tones. The drawing’s colors are primarily muted browns for the medallion and a light beige or off-white for the background. Below the circular design, the name "CHARLOTTE ANGUS" is printed in uppercase letters in a simple, small font, using brown ink.
title: Pa. German Butter Mold
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
